name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SaaS Retention & Account Management | Small-Business Accounts, Save Conversations & Salesforce
summary: SaaS sales and retention professional with 15+ years partnering with small businesses. Retained all but one of 15-20 partners at Birdeye by spotting at-risk accounts in Salesforce early, ranked top three in sales at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, and onboarded 25+ small businesses a month at Wix. Explains APIs and integrations in plain terms.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own client relationships with small service businesses, running discovery to understand goals and recommending solutions that fit, including retainer expansions.
Connect CRMs and client tools through Zapier, Make, and n8n integrations, and explain the setup to non-technical owners.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Resolved client concerns promptly across multi-stakeholder accounts to protect satisfaction and retention, and delivered data-backed recommendations in QBRs.

experience.title: Customer Success & Retention (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners (~94%, deal sizes ~$10K-$45K) serving small businesses across health, home services, and retail.
Analyzed utilization and performance data in Salesforce to identify at-risk accounts and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K (~$130K+ total) and led the sales team.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ small-business clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, and escalated account risk to leadership early.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold a loyalty and marketing automation platform to local small businesses, building a consultative approach to retention and adoption.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
